networks.elmRows: samples_v2.json minus test (2019-2024 or held-out points) minus validation years 2017-2018

design.cases: 3 pilots (chiquimula, jutiapa, sanmartin) x target years 2019-2024 x main maize lost 30, 45, 60 days after sowing = 54
design.soil: Simulator truth uses the pilot SoilGrids soil; the networks get its nearestTexture.
design.timing: Maize sown at the rain-onset rule; the field is free the day after the loss and the next sowing is 14 days later (offset = lossDay + 1 + 14 = 45, 60, 75 days after the onset rule).
actions: fallow (leave the field without a crop / cover: relYield 0, always executable)
design.objective: relYield of the resown crop in the simulator; 0 if its cycle does not complete inside the agricultural year. No margin: this model has no prices or costs.
design.priorities: typical = median of the past years, cautious = 20th percentile
design.informationRule: The decision for year Y uses only agricultural years before Y at that site (bundle truncated to 31 March of Y, then year filter).

policies.mlp: v2 funnel MLP on past years (resown crop as A at its actual sowing date, B = none)
policies.elm: v2 ELM on past years (same encoding)
policies.rule: simple agronomic rule (Alex): resow maize if at least 120 days remain before 15 November, else beans if at least 70, else leave the field
policies.oracle: best action in year Y itself by the simulator

design.tieBreak: higher summary wins; ties go to leaving the field, then to the order maiz, frijol, ajonjoli, papa, cebolla, brocoli, lechuga
design.extrapolationNote: The v2 networks were trained with sowing offsets 0, 15 and 30 days after the onset rule; these cases use 45, 60 and 75, so the networks extrapolate beyond their training range.
design.soilWaterNote: The resown crop is simulated alone from 1 April with a dry soil; water used by the lost maize is not carried over.
